author: MeijiHKitty
body:
It’s a material, like stone and leather

Can be used for things like upgrading certain armour and weapons, but it’s only real use is for increasing your ascension level (each ascension level increases your stats by 1%, and increasing your ascension level while on one class does not pass over when switching classes, but is retained for when you switch back to said class)
